notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.29 Update
notes.notes:
This update fixes a small number of things.

+ Fixed a bug where the Sigma ending wouldn't display property.
+ Fixed a scoring bug where extends aren't awarded until after some time after reaching the score needed for the extra life. 
+ Misc bug fixes and more.

notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.28 Update
notes.notes:
Now this should fix the rest of the problems!
+ Fixed the high score leaderboards as at times the score will register as in 2nd place despite being higher than the 1st place score.
+ Fixed a bug where the No Miss Achievement wouldn't trigger despite clearing the game with no damage.
+ Fixed a display glitch where the recharge bar would show despite not having lost a shield.
+ Your score will now turn gold when you beat the high score.

notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.27 Update
notes.notes:
[strike]Hopefully this will be the last bug fixes in a while[/strike]

+ Fixed the high score ordering glitch
+ Fixed a bug where the endings for characters other than Vian wouldn't appear 
+ Removed the extra comma while in the high score rankings

notes.title: Assault Shell V2.26 Update
notes.notes:
This is a small update that fixes bugs that occurred in the v2.26 update,

+ Fixed a bug where it softlocks if the player enters their initials after clearing Full, Light, or Void mode.
+ Fixed a bug where the scores won't save the billions digit correctly.
+ Fixed a bug where the player's shot in void mode would continuously fire. 
and lesser fixes.

notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.25 Update!
notes.notes:
Phew! There was a lot of bugs that needed to be fixed, but it's time! This update fixes a large majority of bugs found in the earlier versions, and most importantly, fixes the scoring in the game!

Score
+ Fixed the overflow glitch, where the score would revert to a negative once it reaches a certain number over 2 billion.
+ Due to this fix, I've adjusted the scoring in VOID ARRANGE so that when in VOID STAND, the multiplier will be multiplied by x8 instead of x5.
- Changed the score amount needed for an extra life in VOID ARRANGE to 1 billion per extend.

Player Ships
+ AS Alpha's SP Weapon 1 will no longer glitch when bouncing off walls, and will instead bounce towards the nearest enemy.

Ui
+ Modified the way the Shield bar works when charging.
+ The score displayed when entering initials will now display commas for clarity.

Etc.
+ Fixed a bug where the endings for clearing Single, Full, or Light modes wouldn't appear on the ending screen.
+ Fixed a bug where the game slows down due to the sleep margin being too low.

notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.2 Update
notes.notes:
This update is to fix a lot of major bugs, as well as adjusting difficulty in some parts of the game.

Loops
+ Fixed a bug where the player wasn't able to access the 2nd loop in Original Full mode. 

Bosses
- Adjusted the difficulty of the Stage 4B and 4C midbosses. 

Player Ships
+ AS Beta and Gamma are slightly faster
+ Adjusted the main fighter's bullet sprite in Void Arrange

Misc
+ Fixed a bug where the player dialog is skipped when the rank is red in Void Arrange
+ Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: ASSAULT SHELL v2.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Here's the first batch of updates for version 2.0! This includes fixes to gameplay balances, bugs, missing features, and more. 

Player Ships
+ Increased the width of AS Alpha's main shot.
+ AS Alpha's SP Weapon 1 now bounce off the sides.
+ AS Alpha's SP Weapon 2's explosion lasts slightly longer than SP Weapon 1.
+ AS Beta's SP Weapon 2 will grow in size when it begins to expire. 
+ Slightly increased the damage of AS Delta's focus shot.
+ AS Delta's SP Weapon 1 will do a combo of slashes when at max power. The slash size will not be reduced when the weapon is at level 1.
+ AS Delta's  Weapon 2 no longer disappears when flies off the top of the screen.
+ Increased the movement speeds of AS Alpha and AS Delta.

Bosses
+ Added a secret extend on the stage 3 midboss.
- Reduced the difficulty of the stage 1 boss.

 Misc
+ Added an option to toggle vsync
+ Darkened the screen when inputting initials.
